activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1944 during Chern's Institute for Advanced Study residency in Princeton as his representative U.S. differential-geometry milestone, associated with his intrinsic proof of the Gauss-Bonnet formula and characteristic-class work.

sources.title: Shiing-Shen Chern — Institute for Advanced Study
sources.citation_text: The Institute for Advanced Study records Chern in Princeton from 1943-45 and states that during this period he discovered an intrinsic proof of the n-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet formula, a forerunner of invariants bearing his name.
